_top: Round 3: your round 2 rewrites are in, and voice_check no longer flags them. Next are the 3 yellow paragraphs, plus one paragraph to just delete, plus Alexey's quote (waiting for him). Each note quotes the phrases that read as AI and lists the facts to keep.

_focus.note: Delete, don't rewrite: your new opening already says coodie got a day job, so this repeats it. It also ends on a punchline closer ('No pressure.'). If you want to keep one fact, it's that QA looks at Argus before every release, and the Argus section says that too.

_focus.note: 1 of 3, the 'mapper overhead' paragraph. Tells: the staged opener 'Of course,', the tidy saying 'gather just gives you the slow calls in parallel', and an even three-sentence build. 2 of 3, the end of the drivers section. Tells: the punchline closer 'One file, not 47 models.', the 'so thanks, Argus' aside, and the semicolon. Keep: the shared session let services move one by one, it found the execution-profiles bug (#329), and db.py is 'the seam for the future acsylla driver swap' (a quote from the PR, keep it as is).
